messages:
elaine: Hey folks — dropped a Figma link for the API Keys panel iteration. Asking for quick feedback on create / rotate / revoke flows, permission UX, and empty states. https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/API-Keys-Panel
matt: Quick skim — nice. Main callout: rotation UX needs to state whether old key stays valid and for how long. Suggest banner in rotate modal: "New key active immediately. Old key valid for 10 minutes to complete rollouts."
noah: Agreed. Also: show last-used or service-scoped usage so teams know what to revoke. Even a small "last used: 2026-03-18 by backend-service" line helps.
sam: Copy nit on the create flow: current text says "Store this key securely" — propose stronger: "This is the only time you will see the full secret. Save it now." (and a tiny copy link to docs).
ashley: For revoke confirmation, same pattern as infra: require typing the key name to confirm. Less chance of accidental revoke. Also, add a reversible-safety like "soft revoke" where you can immediately disable but still view usage for 24h before hard delete.
elaine: Good ideas. UX questions: should permissions be a dropdown with presets (read-only, embed-only, full) or granular toggles? I lean presets + an "advanced" toggle to expand granular checkboxes. Thoughts?
matt: Presets reduce noise. Advanced for central teams. Also show a summary pill under key name like "Scopes: Generations, Embeddings". Hover for full list.
noah: Accessibility nits: ensure rotate modal traps focus, ESC closes, and the primary action is the most easily reached tab stop. Color contrast for the warning stripe might be low on small screens — bump contrast.
sam: Empty state copy: current placeholder is bland. Proposed: "No API keys yet — create a key to start calling the API." CTA: "Create API key". Small hint under CTA: "You can restrict by role, IP ranges, and set expiry."
design-bot: UX checklist suggestion added to Figma comments: 1) Show last-used/service mapping 2) Rotation grace banner 3) Copy for single-view secret + download button 4) Revoke requires typed name 5) Preset scopes + advanced toggle 6) ARIA attributes & keyboard flows
ashley: One more: when creating, let users choose expiry (never, 30d, 90d). Show an estimated security score on the right (green/yellow/red) based on expiry + scopes.
matt: Ops ask: include a small audit-log link next to every key: "View in Audit Logs" so support can triage. Also expose an API to rotate programmatically.
noah: Copy suggestion for rotate modal (short):
```
Rotate API key
New key created — this is the only time you will see the secret. Old key will remain valid for 10 minutes to allow deployments to pick up the new key. Update your services and then confirm rotation.
```
sam: For the revoke modal copy suggestion: "Revoke API key \"<key-name>\"? This will immediately stop all requests authenticated with this key. To prevent accidental revokes, type the key name to confirm."
elaine: Design follow-ups: can someone prototype the presets + advanced expansion? also add tooltip examples for scopes (one-liners).
matt: I can mock presets later today. Will add tooltip text.
ashley: Accessibility: will run the panel through VoiceOver/ChromeVox and report anomalies.
noah: Small implementation note: please make the secrets rendered using a masked input with a "copy" button, and only expose full string in the one-time download. No full secret in logs.
sam: +1 on logs. Also consider promoting an SDK flow where you can rotate server-side using the rotate API so secrets are never human-copied.
elaine: thanks all — consolidated action items in Figma comments and a follow-up meeting Friday 10am to review mocks. :thumbsup:
matt: :thumbsup:
noah: LGTM
ashley: Will test accessibility and report by Thu
elaine: Closing the thread now — will post updated frames when ready.
